# Computing and AI Careers Fair, Tuesday 10th November {#cai}

Our annual Computing Careers fair is an opportunity for employers to meet undergraduate and postgraduate students in Computer Science. It takes place every autumn on campus, alongside other careers fairs across the University. To register your interest for the fair, taking place on Tuesday 10th November from 10am to 3pm, please register at [forms.cloud.microsoft/e/5mhxWMJvwf](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/5mhxWMJvwf).


![The Computing Careers Fair takes place every year in the foyer of the Nancy Rothwell Building, home to the School of Engineering at the University of Manchester](computing-careers-fair2.png)

## Venue: The Nancy Rothwell Building {#rothwell}

The Computing and AI Careers fair takes place in the foyer of the [Nancy Rothwell Building](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nancy_Rothwell_Building) pictured below.

![The foyer of the Nancy Rothwell building is spacious and light with high footfall from students in Computer Science and other departments in the [School of Engineering](https://www.se.manchester.ac.uk/about/schools-and-departments/school-of-engineering/)](careers-fair-rothwell.png)



## More careers fairs {#careers}

The Computing and AI careers fair is one of several hosted by the University including:

* The Law Fair
* The STEM fair, for Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics
* The Careers in Mathematics and Statistics (CiMaS) Fair
* The School of Biological Sciences (SBS) Fair
* and more, see [www.careers.manchester.ac.uk/events/fairs](https://www.careers.manchester.ac.uk/events/fairs/)
